articles.summary: September 9, 2026 – Vancouver, British Columbia – Trilogy Metals Inc. (NYSE American / TSX: TMQ) (“Trilogy Metals”, “Trilogy” or the “Company”) announced that it has been named to the 2026 TSX30, an annual ranking of the top-performing companies on the Toronto Stock Exchange over a three-year period, based on dividend-adjusted share price appreciation.
